1949, subject to certain modifications see The Chittagong Hill‑tracts
(Laws) Regulation, 1952 (E. B. Reg. III of 1952), s. 2, and Sch.)
[9th July, 1880]
1. Short title. This Act may by called the Kazis Act, 1880 ;
(The words "and it shall come into
force at once" rep. by the Repealing and Amending Act, 1914 (10 of 1914).) Local extent * * * * * * *
(The words "It extends, in the first
instance, only to the territories ad ministered by the Governor Fort Saint
George in Council. But "omitted by A. O., 1949, Sch.)* * * (Subs. ibid., for "any other".)[The] (Subs. by A. O., 1937, for "L.
G.")[Provincial
Government] may from time to time, by notification in the official Gazette,
extend it to the whole or any part of the territories under its
administrations.( The Act has been extended to certain places in Bengal, the

Applied

Power to appoint Kazis for any local area

THE KAZIS ACT, 1880
THE KAZIS ACT, 1880
ACT No. XII of 1880
(For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see
Gazette of India, 1880, Pt. V., p. 21 ; for the Report of the Select Committee,
see ibid, Pt. V., p. 203 ; for discussions in Council, see ibid., Supplement,
pp. 345, 356 and 1203.
This Act
shall apply to the Chittagong Hill‑tracts with effect from the 21st June
1949, subject to certain modifications see The Chittagong Hill‑tracts
(Laws) Regulation, 1952 (E. B. Reg. III of 1952), s. 2, and Sch.)
[9th July, 1880]
2. Power to appoint Kazis for any local area. Wherever it appears
to the (Subs.
by A. O., 1937, for "L. G.")[Provincial Government] that
:
any considerable number of the
Muhammadans resident in any app local area desire that one or more Kazis should
be appointed for Kazis such local area, the (Subs. by A. O., 1937, for "L.
G.")[Provincial
Government] may, if it thinks any fit, after consulting the principal
Muhammadan residents of such local area, select one or more fit persons and
appoint him or them to be Kazis for such local area. "If any question
arises whether any person has been rightly appointed Kazi under this section,
the decision thereof by the (Subs. by A. O., 1937, for "L. G.") [Provincial Government] shall be
conclusive.
The (Subs. by A. O., 1937, for "L.
G.") [Provincial
Government] may, if it thinks fit, suspend or remove any Kazi appointed under
this section who is guilty of any misconduct in the execution of his office, or
who is for a continuous period of six months absent from the local area for which
he is appointed, or leaves such local area for the purpose of residing
elsewhere, or is declared an insolvent, or desires to be discharged from the
office, or who refuses or becomes in the opinion of the (Subs. by A. O., 1937, for "L.
G.") [Provincial
Government] unfit, or personally incapable, to dis charge the duties of the
office.

Naib Kazis

THE KAZIS ACT, 1880
THE KAZIS ACT, 1880
ACT No. XII of 1880
(For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see
Gazette of India, 1880, Pt. V., p. 21 ; for the Report of the Select Committee,
see ibid, Pt. V., p. 203 ; for discussions in Council, see ibid., Supplement,
pp. 345, 356 and 1203.
This Act
shall apply to the Chittagong Hill‑tracts with effect from the 21st June
1949, subject to certain modifications see The Chittagong Hill‑tracts
(Laws) Regulation, 1952 (E. B. Reg. III of 1952), s. 2, and Sch.)
[9th July, 1880]
3. naib Kazis. Any Kazi appointed under this Act may appoint one or
more persons as his naib or naibs to act in his place in all or any of the
matters appertaining to his office throughout the whole or in any portion of
the local area for which he is appointed, and may suspend or remove any naib so
appointed.
When any Kazi is suspended or
removed under section 2, his naib or naibs (if any) shall be deemed to be
suspended or removed, as the case may be.

Nothing in act to confer judicial or administrative powers; or to render the presence of Kazi necessary or to prevent any one acting as Kazi

THE KAZIS ACT, 1880
THE KAZIS ACT, 1880
ACT No. XII of 1880
(For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see
Gazette of India, 1880, Pt. V., p. 21 ; for the Report of the Select Committee,
see ibid, Pt. V., p. 203 ; for discussions in Council, see ibid., Supplement,
pp. 345, 356 and 1203.
This Act
shall apply to the Chittagong Hill‑tracts with effect from the 21st June
1949, subject to certain modifications see The Chittagong Hill‑tracts
(Laws) Regulation, 1952 (E. B. Reg. III of 1952), s. 2, and Sch.)
[9th July, 1880]
4. Nothing in act to confer judicial or administrative powers; or to
render the presence of Kazi necessary or to prevent any one acting as Kazi.
Nothing herein contained, and no appointment made hereunder, shall be deemed‑
(a) to confer any judicial or
administrative powers on any Kazi or Naib Kazi appointed hereunder ; or
(b) to render the presence of a
Kazi or Naib Kazi necessary at the celebration of any marriage or the
performance of any rite or ceremony ; or
(c) to prevent any person
discharging any of the functions of a Kazi.
